entries.summary: Mirage maps IsEnabled explicitly so browser-native select interaction remains deterministic across runtime hosts without becoming click-through when disabled.

Mirage does not infer IsOpen=true from raw focus events because browser focus does not reliably indicate native picker-popup visibility; successful programmatic open requests are the strongest browser signal available, and close reconciliation still comes from change/blur.
Mirage projects VerticalTextAlignment through deterministic native-select padding adjustments, but browser-native select chrome may not match Android/iOS picker text positioning exactly.
